verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP/CLI docs explicitly mention agents that can 'query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping' and 'automate month-end checks' (kick-docs-15, kick-docs-16, kick-docs-24), and reconciliation itself is documented as comparing Kick's records against bank statements for mismatches (kick-supp-reconciliation). Exception-style flagging exists via confidence-gated categorization (low-confidence items left for manual review, kick-supp-categorization) and human review is enforced via accountant period locks (kick-supp-locks). However, there is no documented example or workflow showing an agent autonomously executing the full reconciliation-to-close pipeline (matching + exception list + close prep) as a single orchestrated task — missing for 10: an end-to-end reconciliation-specific exception report generated by AI, a documented 'agent-led close' workflow, and independent/hands-on confirmation that MCP tools can actually perform bank-vs-ledger matching rather than just categorization and reporting.
